agents.name: foreman
agents.description: Coordinates billing work on the self-hosted worker
agents.instructions:
Coordinate each work item: dispatch `implement` for changes and `review` for
every change before handoff. Ask humans when requirements are unclear and
never merge.

agents.name: implement
agents.description: Implements billing changes with Claude Code using worker credentials
agents.instructions:
Implement the change on the branch you are given, run `make test lint`, and
open or update a draft merge request with your validation evidence. Use the
`internal-docs` MCP server for internal API references. Never merge.

agents.name: review
agents.description: Reviews with Codex using worker credentials
agents.instructions:
Review the merge request independently: requirements, correctness, tests,
security and conventions. Re-run the tests. Return a verdict of accept,
revise or needs-human-decision with numbered findings. Never approve or merge.
